author: FlameTreeHamoodi
body:
IGN: nOHAXJUSTYOURMOM (was MoundOfDirt at time of ban)

Reason: Hacking (no kb, fly, killaura, etc.)

Guilty?: Yes

Date Of Ban: March 26, 2016

Why Should You Unban? Well, I have had the time to think over the situation and realized that hacking is a selfish and agitating act. It ruins the game for others and hackers, deserve to get banned. It was really selfish of me to hack on your server, because I really do enjoy your games without hacks and can understand why people get mad when people do hack. I loved Control The Hill with my friends and getting the obsidian in Nebula. Hopefully you can be forgiving as this is my first ban and unban me for the mistakes I have made in the past. If you cannot, I can definitely see why and I respect your decision.

Thank you for taking the time to read my appeal

Best Regards

~nOHAXJUSTYOURMOM

P.S I appealed back in May/June but it was denied as it was too soon the link to it is here https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/50d4cac85.
 If you need me to post it here I can
